title: Localized tensor comparison triangle: fixed representative step
statement: Under the hypotheses of the localized tensor comparison triangle, for a fixed distinguished triangle, fixed K-flat representative U of its third vertex, fixed K-flatness witness, fixed base-derived tensor model mU and degree i, the comparison morphism at i is an isomorphism whenever the first two vertices satisfy the localized comparison property.

source.place: Tag 0DJA(1), five-lemma step in the triangle closure argument

proof.text: Construct K-flat representatives U1 and U2 of T.obj1 and T.obj2 using the already proved source-library ModuleCat.hasFunctorialFlatResolution instance, the reduced resolution functor and kFlat_resolutionFunctor_obj. Compose Q of its quasi-isomorphism with Q.objObjPreimageIso. The private helper exists_kFlat_representative converts the source-library K-flat predicate to the explicit acyclic tensor predicate via the homotopy quotient characterization.
Obtain base-derived models m1 and m2 for U1 tensor Q and U2 tensor Q from nonempty_baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel.

Apply the exact five-term diagram construction with these representatives and models and the prescribed third representative U, model mU and degree i. It supplies two exact rows, a morphism phi and arrow isomorphisms identifying all five components with the actual comparison composites.

Evaluate h1 and h2 at U1 and U2, their representative isomorphisms and K-flatness proofs, and their models, in degrees i and i+1. Transport these four IsIso proofs to components 0,1,3,4 using Arrow.isIso_iff_isIso_of_isIso.

Apply the Mathlib five lemma to the exact rows and phi. Components 0 and 4 are respectively epi and mono because they are isomorphisms; components 1 and 3 are isomorphisms. This proves component 2 is invertible.
Transport invertibility of component 2 along its arrow isomorphism to the displayed comparison for the prescribed U and mU. No hypothesis or conclusion of the original statement changes.

theorem localizedTensorComparisonProperty_triangle_core
    (hC : Module.Flat (A ⊗[R] B) C)
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (T : Pretriangulated.Triangle (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)))
    (hT : T ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles)
    (h1 : localizedTensorComparisonProperty R A B C Q N t T.obj₁)
    (h2 : localizedTensorComparisonProperty R A B C Q N t T.obj₂)
    (U : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hU : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj U ≅ T.obj₃))
    (hUK : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V U (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (mU : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C)
    (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    IsIso (mU.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t)) i)
